result.title: SpecRelay: Amortize or Avoid the Round Trip in Edge-Cloud Speculative Decoding
result.summary: Edge-cloud speculative decoding moves autoregressive drafting to an edge device while a larger cloud model verifies draft tokens in parallel, so that edge drafting and cloud verification overlap under a synchronous draft-verify schedule. Beyond low-latency local networks, however, the next verification request of that schedule can be sent only after the previous reply arrives, so every round still waits out a full round trip, and throughput falls as the network RTT grows. To recover this loss, we present SpecRelay, an edge-cloud LLM inference system that addresses this cost at two levels: it amortizes round trips when cloud verification is necessary and avoids them when local reasoning suffices. For cloud-bound queries, an asynchronous verification pipeline keeps fixed-budget draft trees in flight while earlier replies are still outstanding, and the cloud rejects stale requests before the target-model forward pass (the asynchronous schedule). At the query level, an RTT-conditioned router (the Latency-Aware Router) estimates quality and completion latency for three on-device modes (direct generation, Chain-of-Draft, and full reasoning) and cloud speculative decoding, selecting among them under a configurable accuracy-latency objective without adding latency during inference, since the router runs concurrently with the draft-model prefill. The asynchronous schedule alone improves decoding throughput by up to 50% over a reproduced synchronous baseline across multiple benchmarks. At matched target-model accuracy and 250 ms of added round-trip latency, the full system with the router delivers 1.95x and 1.55x the throughput of the same baseline on SPROUT and OlympiadBench, respectively, while sending only 47% and 39% of the queries to the cloud.

AI.brief_summary: 提出边缘-云 LLM 推理系统 SpecRelay：用异步验证流水线在等待回复期间持续发出投机解码草稿树以摊薄 RTT，并用延迟感知路由器在三种端侧推理模式与云端投机解码间按精度-延迟目标选择。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「本地推理是否足够、何时仍需云端验证」的延迟条件化模式路由与陈旧请求拒绝，为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的计算分配与获取证据收益-成本权衡提供问题表述层面的类比，可供核查；但材料未涉及视觉证据或 latent 状态，联系仅停留在决策与成本层面。
